description: University LMS-embedded AI learning assistant developed by the Product Innovation Team to support student learning through content questions and Socratic revision.
howToObtain: Available in Canvas LMS subject sites when enabled by the Subject Coordinator.
costToUser: Not specified in cited source; embedded in Canvas LMS when enabled by Subject Coordinator.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The University’s Product Innovation Team has developed the AI learning assistant (AILA): a chatbot embedded in the LMS and intended as a learning resource for students.

description: Secure internal University GenAI platform for staff handling sensitive University information, accessible at spark.unimelb.edu.au; student access is strictly prohibited.
howToObtain: Staff access SparkAI at spark.unimelb.edu.au with University credentials.
costToUser: Not specified in cited source; internal platform accessible to staff with University credentials.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: SparkAI is a secure platform internal to the University of Melbourne that can be accessed by staff (but not by students). It allows staff to explore Generative AI tools and capabilities using information that may be sensitive to the University, such as teaching/assignment materials, potentially copyrighted material, or other data that have Intellectual Property overlays.

description: Staff-facing diagnostic tool in Canvas LMS similarity reports used as an investigative prompt; it is not standalone proof of academic misconduct and not a student generative tool.
howToObtain: Staff access similarity reports in Canvas LMS.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Turnitin’s AI writing detection tool is currently accessible to staff within Canvas as part of its similarity report function, for work submitted in English.

description: Student-account Chat includes study support and note upload stored privately in OneDrive without training. It does not include integrated M365 Copilot.
howToObtain: Log in with Unimelb student account online or via web app.
costToUser: Included with student account; integrated M365 Copilot license is not included.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: M365 Copilot Chat provides a secure, AI-powered chat experience grounded in web knowledge and powered by GPT. While students are allowed to use GenAI for study, all work submitted for assessment must follow the rules of the assessment and, if AI use is permitted, students must ensure this is acknowledged as described in Academic Integrity: unauthorised or undisclosed use of technology.
